column5: Vulkan decode on Raven2. The Qwen3.8-4B distill at Q4_K_M decodes at 3.07 tokens per second with every layer on the Vulkan device. The two Vega compute units and the two Zen+ cores draw on one DDR4-2133 controller, so a split placement adds synchronization without adding bandwidth. FIXTURE-PAGE-RAVEN2-END
